intro: I found the duplicate reel I kept from the incident paperwork. It includes a later contact amendment, not just the original flight record.
I never had a reader. A strip of tiny rectangles is not a forwarding address. I still do not know where John is.
Take it to Drebin. Compare the record identifiers before comparing the fields. I would prefer not to confess to two unrelated filing errors.
success: The retained contact amendment names Warsaw and reference WAW-17. This is the lead for finding John; it does not record an in-person meeting or identify who tried to harm him.

messages.ready: Ask Alex for his retained reel, then compare it in the archive.
messages.complete: Warsaw lead recorded. Next: travel to Warsaw and follow contact reference WAW-17.
messages.unfinished: Microfilm progress saved. Return to the reader when ready.
messages.saveFailed: Saving failed. Progress remains in memory; save manually before closing.
messages.loadFailed: The microfilm view could not be opened. Nothing was lost.
